The pods are healthy, so stop looking at them. Ask the Service who's behind it: `kubectl -n dojo-endpoints get endpoints api`. If it says `<none>`, the Service matches no pods — that's the whole bug.

Compare two things: `kubectl -n dojo-endpoints get svc api -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'` (what the Service looks for) against `kubectl -n dojo-endpoints get pods --show-labels` (what the pods have). They don't match.

Fix the Service's `spec.selector` to the label the pods actually carry (`app=api`): `kubectl -n dojo-endpoints patch svc api --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"api"}}}'`. Endpoints populate within a second. Don't relabel the pods or hand-craft an Endpoints object.
